description: The system shall allow users to initiate a session using their email or phone number.
The system shall allow the user to enter an email address or phone number.
The system shall send an OTP code to the indicated address or number.
The user shall be able to enter the received OTP code.
If the code is correct, the user shall log in successfully.
The system shall handle authentication errors and incorrect codes.
The system shall display a Home screen with relevant business information.
The Home screen shall display several independent informative widgets.
Each widget shall load its data autonomously.
The system shall display loading and error states when necessary.
The system shall provide intelligent response suggestions for reviews via the Cintia AI agent.
The system shall detect if the user has the Cintia functionality activated.
If Cintia is active, the system shall display a response suggestion automatically upon opening the response modal.
The system shall display the response progressively (typing effect).
The user shall be able to edit or replace the suggested response.
If the user lacks Cintia credits, the system shall notify them and provide a button to purchase more.
The system shall allow users to view images and videos associated with a review.
The system shall display images and videos associated with a review under the review text.
Images shall be navigable via horizontal scroll.
Upon clicking an image or video, it shall be displayed in full screen.
The system shall allow users to access the application menu from different screens.
The menu shall be accessible from more than one screen via the user's profile image.
The application must provide an intuitive and consistent interface that allows users to complete main tasks without prior training.
Main functionalities can be used without errors after a first use; no external instructions are required to complete basic actions.
The application must function correctly on Android and iOS devices with different screen sizes and supported OS versions.
The application is displayed and functions correctly on emulators and physical Android and iOS devices.
System responses must have an acceptable response time, avoiding blocking or freezing of the user interface.
Main calls to the backend return a response in a time perceived as acceptable by the user.
User data must be transmitted and managed securely, ensuring that only authorized users can access the information.
Access to functionalities requires valid authentication and unauthorized access is not permitted.
The code must be structured following good practices and architecture patterns that facilitate the maintenance and evolution of the system.
The code follows a clear architecture and is reviewable via PRs without difficulty.
